description: 서울교통공사_지하철 호선별 첫차와 막차 정보(전철역코드,외부코드) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울교통공사. 서울교통공사지하철 호선별 첫차와 막차 정보(전철역코드,외부코드) API는 지하철 호선 또는 역별 첫번째, 마지막 열차운행시각표 정보를 검색할 수 있는 API입니다. (호선, 외부코드, 전철역코드, 역사명, 방향, 도착시간, 출발시간, 출발역, 도착역 등) [제공범위] - 서울교통공사에서 운영하는 1~9... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울교통공사. Its tags are 전철역코드, 외부코드, 첫차, 서울지하철, 도시철도. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
